title: Writing with inkpen.ogg (PDSounds no. 179, "writing with inkpen", 2007)
author: stephan (via pdsounds.org; transferred to Commons by Fæ)
used_as: pen-on-paper scratch, cut into a 36-grain bank (one grain per written stroke: balloon outlines, tail stubs, every glyph stroke, S1 header/labels, S0 brush strokes low-passed) and 6 pen-down taps (full stops, "?", S1 panel stamps); also one grain per stroke for the page footer written on in S5

title: Audio Hörbild Grillenzirpen - nachts um 3 im Föhrenwald Mödling.ogg (2020)
author: DrTrumpet (Wikimedia Commons user), own work
used_as: distant night ambience bed for the whole film: deep pauses cut, kept spans joined with 1 s crossfades, looped with 1.5 s crossfades, low RMS, fade in over S0, fade out over the last 2 s; A3 is this bed alone
